notes.title: [Important] About BARRICADEZ range of support
notes.content:
Thank you for continuing to play BARRICADEZ!

After the full release of Version1.00 on 2021/09/30,
we have had a number of bug reports and issues.
We are terribly sorry for any inconveniences.

We have not been following every fix with an update report,
but we are fixing many of the issues in order of severity.
(Current version is ver1.00.007)
There are still some elusive issues that are difficult to find and fix.

Find the current list below:
[list]
[*]When there are many Facilities and Excavators, there are reports of slowdowns and FPS drops
[*]During this time, you may experience some screen flashing
[*]During this time, Aggressors may glitch through some Facilities
[*]Aggressors may move unpredictably as in-game days increase
[/list]

You can continue *indefinitely after clearing with the 'Good Ending'
As in-game days pass, items, Facilities, Traps, and Aggressors may get out of hand, 
and there will be a chance of unexpected behavior.

We the BARRICADEZ Team and BARRICADEZ may have its imperfections,
but we are working hard to expand its entertainment value.

Many Players have requested about saving the map for The Caves between sessions. We are planning to implement this.
Thank you for playing, and do your best to protect that Cradle!

notes.title: Release alpha4.00
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing BARRICADEZ.
In this update In addition to adding new features and new facilities,
We have broadly expanded things such as additional story parts and controller support.

There is a new [Drone Port] in addition to the new and improved Item Puller -> [Drone Warehouse]
Craft and set Drones in the Drone Port, and they will automatically carry resources 
from Excavator Robots in The Caves, or other Chests in your base!
Smart, efficient crafting has never been so easy!

With Drones, you can now repair the newly added [Radio Tower] in STORY Mode.
The STORY scenes may change depending on the Radio Tower status.
Let's try to complete the repairs by Day 100.
Also, with higher Radio Tower levels, your Radar in The Caves will be upgraded.

There are new STORY scenes at Day 100.
We have adjusted some of the original scenes to fit with this change.
If you are unable to complete the Radio Tower by Day 100, it will be GAME OVER.
If you load an older save version, you will be able to continue past 100 regardless.
In order to grab this opportunity, consider starting from the beginning.

We have added in controller support to BARRICADEZ.
You should be able to plug and play with ease.
Select your controller type in [Settings] > [Key Config] > [ Controller Type].
If the type doesn't match, the controller won't work as intended.
※In the Steam Launcher, go to Settings> Controller> General Controller Settings,
and set "PlayStation Configuration Support" and "Xbox Configuration Support" to OFF. 

New Difficulty [Tungsten] has been added.
For elite BARRICADEZ Players, this will be your newest highest challenge.
For those seeking the next thrill, be sure to try it out!

The [Continue] function has been updated.
You may choose from a few starting dates and return to that time.
You can return to the selected time while keeping your base, Engrams, and skills.
You may also choose to Re-Generate The Caves, so
if you are running low on resources, please consider doing so.
Note: The game will start in Building Mode.
Please ensure that the Cradle is in a safe position before starting.
[h3]■ Patch notes[/h3]
Old version save data may not be usable in PRACTICE and CHALLENGE Modes.
We understand that this can be frustrating, but we thank you for your patience.
[/list]
[h3]■ updates list[/h3][list]
[*] [Facility] Added [Drone Port]
[*] [Facility] Renamed Item Puller to [Drone Warehouse] and added new features
[*] [Other] Widespread balance changes
[*] [Other] Added difficulty [Tungsten]
[*] [Other] Adjusted the Continue feature
[*] [Other] Added [Radio Tower] and repair function
[*] [Other] Added new STORY scenes
[*] [Other] Added Controller support
[*] [Other] Changed font for Japanese text
[*] [Other] Major adjustments to length, difficulty of PRACTICE and CHALLENGE levels
[*] [Other] Adjusted [Detail] window of In-Game UI
[/list]
[h3]■ Other minor bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] [Other] Fixed Vertical Excavator Robot radar bug
[*] [Other] Fixed frame drops when starting Building Mode from 3x speed
[*] [Other] Fixed error messages and odd behavior in RED MOON RUSH
[*] [Other] Adjusted Dynamite to allow bullets to pass through
[*] [Other] Mining charge description of required skill level fixed to reflect actual needed level
[*] [Other] Fixed strange behavior of the Lift
[*] [Other] New recipes from Blueprints now have a NEW displayed

*If you are still unable to get the achievement, also try placing a Landmine
[/list]
We are dedicated to bringing regular updates to the game, so thank you for playing!

notes.title: Release alpha3.30
notes.content:
Release alpha3.30
We've once again added some brand new features in BARRICADEZ!
Some items are somewhat incomplete, with the finishing touches to be added at a later date.

New [Blueprints] are now added
If you find the Blueprints hidden in the caves,
you will be able to build newer, stronger Facilities.
Additionally, find the right Blueprint and you'll find the newest game feature!

New [Lift] is now implemented!
With the Lift, you can ride between connected Lift Relays.
Also, the Lift will have a chest installed, so you can carry
and move extra materials down in The Caves
You can find a Lift or Lift Relay near the bottom layer of The Caves,
so let's find them and hop on!

In addition, we have made some major balancing changes.
Some Trap, Facility, and Aggressor behaviors have been adjusted.
While listening to all of your valuable feedback,
We hope to improve and adjust until BARRICADEZ becomes the best it can be.

There is still much to do, and so many things to improve.
We will continue lightening the load as well as continue adding new features.
We hope to turn this into the best game possible.
[h3]■ Patch notes[/h3]
In alpha3.20, you were able to upgrade to Lv5 Facilities by unlocking the appropriate skill,
but from 3.30 on, you will be able to find the Blueprint for each new Facility in The Caves.
In order to put this into effect, you may experience abnormalities
regarding unshown crafting progress in your Craft Facilities.
Also, you may not  be able to collect the items inside,
so please [SHIFT + Click] on the Facility from the Field.
Completed items will be able to be collected this way, so please try it.

The content of the game balancing is as follows:
Facilities that allow bullets to pass, now also allow thrown Bombers to pass through.
(Bombers can be thrown by Pitchers - this will be especially deadly after this update)
If you continue with your current save data, you may want to re-prepare your base.
As shown in the image below, Bombers can pass through Facilities such as the Workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36370243/04702434e5812fe5e40b17e550e0cfbe2d84b070.png[/img]

The Lift added in this update will still see further adjustment in coming updates.
It is likely that the functions may be changed in the future.

The Lift and Blueprint will be generated in The Caves.
Because of this, Save Data from previous versions will need to 
use the [Re-Generate Terrain] option to see the items in-game.

*There will be a dialog option for [Re-Generate Terrain] in old saves.
[/list]
[h3]■ updates list[/h3][list]
[*] [Facility] New Facility [Lift] added
[*] [Other] New [Blueprints] added
[*] [Other] Widespread balance changes
[*] [Other] CHALLENGE Stage added
[/list]
[h3]■ Other minor bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] [Enemy] Fixed unintended behavior of Pitcher
[*] [Other] Certain actions during Facility collection caused game-breaking errors - fixed
[/list]
We are dedicated to bringing regular updates to the game, so thank you for playing!

notes.title: Release alpha3.10
notes.content:
In this update, our goal was to improve our well-received Augments, as
well as some other bread and butter improvements!
Use these to your advantage, and aim to survive 100 days!

We added the [Beacon] Facility!
When you equip an Augment to a Beacon, it will share the effect with Traps nearby.
It is a little expensive, but can be a powerful tool when used wisely.

We have largely improved the minimap!
You can now see explored areas and resources from the minimap.
Use this to find rare resources and Augments.
*Explored area won't be included in save data
   We are working to make the map area saveable in the future.

Now introducing; [Hidden Power Augments]!
These Augments will level up and get stronger when the equipped trap deals damage or defeats enemies.
They are very valuable, so be careful that your equipped trap isn't destroyed!

In this update, you may experience issues when loading data in CHALLENGE mode.
For now, please continue your CHALLENGE Mode data in the previous version.

You may experience some slowdown when loading the game.
We are working on solving this problem, so please bare with us.
※If the program is not responding, please wait and the game may start soon.

notes.title: Release alpha2.00
notes.content:
In this new version, we've added new game modes and ways to play!

We've added [PRACTICE] Mode to help new players learn the basics
but our veterans might also pick up some new tricks!

There is a new [CHALLENGE] Mode with a few resource-restricted challenges.
You can get some rewards based on your performance, so be sure to try it out!

[RED MOON RUSH] is a mode for testing the strength of your STORY mode base.
Play through night after night of only red moons!

There are new Facilities and improved Traps!
[Time Warp] will allow you to keep your items and base camp, but turn back time.
[Floating Column] can allow you to build farther without support from the ground.
[Pitfall] is being re-introduced to activate on enemy count, rather than enemy weight
[High Octane Trap Fuel] greatly improves the attack power and speed of your traps, with a few drawbacks, as well

We've added fall damage when you drop Aggressors from high places.
To pair with that, we added a skill to increase your maximum build height!
Test out the new fall damage with your new, taller base!

We've finally implemented Steam Achievements for BARRICADEZ
Try to get them all so you can brag to your friends!

There is a new BGM track, and we are sure you'll love it!
[h3](Patch notes)[/h3]
After upgrading to this version, any save before this game version no longer can be read.
If you wish to continue your previous game save, please select "Properties" from library at Steam launcher
In the BETAS menu, select "Select the beta you would like to opt into"
And switch to your game save version

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36370243/85bafc0162cd6dabb25def09d4cc258d1880119f.png[/img]
*Return the settings to default at any time to try our new update!

[*] New Title Background
[*] The mode from previous versions renamed to [STORY] mode
[*] [PRACTICE] mode implemented
[*] [CHALLENGE] mode implemented
[*] Steam Achievements implemented
[*] New BGM implemented (1 song)
*You can hear it at night in STORY mode
[*] Adjusted resource amounts to last longer on the left/right sides in The Caves
[*] [Skill] Maximum Build Height skill implemented
[*] [Enemy] Fall damage for Aggressors implemented
[*] [Facility] Facilities liable to fall when exiting Building Mode now show a down arrow
[*] [Facility] Floating Column implemented
*Used to connect and support facilities in the air

*Now opens based on the amount of large enemies
*Allows other enemy types to fall when triggered by large enemies
[*] [Facility] Time Warp facility implemented in The Caves
*Use this facility to travel back in time 3 days, but keep all of your items and base camp
*This facility will disappear after use
[*] [Facility] The Chemistry Station can now craft High Octane Trap Fuel

In order to make the best gaming experience for you, the player,
We are doing our best to develop new, interesting features regularly.
The BARRICADEZ Team sends its love and appreciation!

notes.title: Colossal Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BARRICADEZ!
We are planning a large update somewhere in the middle of August
The gist of the new content is as follows:

[h3] 1) Achievements [/h3]
New achievements have been added for BARRICADEZ on Steam!
Unlock them by clearing tasks and reaching certain milestones in-game
There are 35 achievements this time, and more being planned for the future.
Let's play and try to get them all!

[h3] 2) PRACTICE Mode[/h3]
Have you ever been confused on how to use Traps or Facilities?
This is a mode aimed at onboarding for new or confused players.
If you are new to the game, hopefully you can enjoy the new mode!

[h3] 3) CHALLENGE Mode[/h3]
Are you ready for a change? Tired of the same old story?
This mode tests your skills with new play style and enemy patterns
You have to know your Trap strengths and Enemy weaknesses!

[h3] 4) RED MOON RUSH[/h3]
A scary and fierce mode with continuous Red Moon nights
Test your strongest Story Mode base against the waves of every 7th night in sequence.
How many rounds will your best base be able to last?

[h3] 5) Skills and Facilities[/h3]
We've added skills to increase your build height,
a device to turn back time,
and a new type of ammo to repel the endless waves more efficiently!

These are the main changes we've made, with more small ones packaged in.
In order to make the best gaming experience for you, the player,
We are doing our best to develop new, interesting features regularly.
The BARRICADEZ Team sends its love and appreciation!

notes.title: Release alpha1.12
notes.content:
In this update, we've added new traps and enemies!
With the new [Item Puller], you can select exactly what items to pull from the facility above.
Try it out! It is like a new and improved chest!
We are also making adjustments to some crafting processes and recipes.
Please check your crafting progress if you load from an older version.

notes.title: Brand new「Craft + Tower Defense」experience!
notes.content:
Collect materials and items underground, and craft them on the ground!
Build a unique base and slash enemies!

In current version game have following functions.
- You can challenge to survive for how long against the infinitely stronger enemies.
- Game will limited to 28th day in game time (First goal)
- Excavating underground (Excavating utilize excavation robot or by player)
- And underground ruins (You can get useful items from chest) 
- Craft facilities (Workbench, chemistry workbench and forge)
- Storage facilities (chest and supply depot, auto supply fuel and ammunition for trap) 
- Trap (9 traps now and more in the future)
- Various block (differences between projectiles can passes through or not)
- Enemy (8 type of enemy and more in the future)
- AutoCraft (an item by connecting the connector can be passed to the facility below)
- Construction mode (to stop the fall of the facility, it can help to re-arrange spaces)

[h3]■ Attention[/h3]There may have bug
May have possibility of damage to the saved data.

Since we have only a few people involved in development, there may be some glitchs, but we sincerely hope you like it.
